learningOutcomes.title: Learning Outcomes
learningOutcomes.intro: Below are the seven CAS learning outcomes. Each outcome explains a learning goal students should demonstrate through their CAS experiences, with examples and indicators to help identify achievement.
learningOutcomes.LO1_title: LO1 — Identify strengths and areas for growth
learningOutcomes.LO1_desc: Students should be able to recognise their personal strengths and weaknesses, reflect on them, and set realistic goals to develop. Evidence includes self-reflection, seeking feedback, and showing improvement over time in skills or behaviours.
learningOutcomes.LO1: Students should be able to recognise their personal strengths and weaknesses, reflect on them, and set realistic goals to develop.
learningOutcomes.LO2_title: LO2 — Undertake new challenges and develop skills
learningOutcomes.LO2_desc: Students undertake tasks outside their comfort zone, demonstrating risk-taking, perseverance and the development of new abilities. Evidence includes trying unfamiliar roles, persisting through setbacks, and acquiring technical or interpersonal skills.
learningOutcomes.LO2: Students undertake tasks outside their comfort zone, demonstrating risk-taking, perseverance and the development of new abilities.
learningOutcomes.LO3_title: LO3 — Plan and initiate CAS experiences
learningOutcomes.LO3_desc: Students demonstrate initiative by conceiving, planning and organising CAS activities. This includes identifying objectives, resources, timelines and responsibilities, as well as adapting plans when needed.
learningOutcomes.LO3: Students demonstrate initiative by conceiving, planning and organising CAS activities, including identifying objectives and resources.
learningOutcomes.LO4_desc: Students show sustained engagement with activities over time, balancing commitments and demonstrating responsibility. Evidence includes completing long-term projects, regular attendance, and steady contribution to group tasks.
learningOutcomes.LO4: Students show sustained engagement with activities over time, balancing commitments and demonstrating responsibility.
learningOutcomes.LO5_title: LO5 — Work collaboratively and recognise benefits
learningOutcomes.LO5_desc: Students demonstrate teamwork, communication and leadership within groups. They reflect on how collaboration enhances outcomes, manage conflicts constructively, and value diverse perspectives.
learningOutcomes.LO5: Students demonstrate teamwork, communication and leadership within groups, and reflect on how collaboration enhances outcomes.
learningOutcomes.LO6_title: LO6 — Demonstrate engagement with issues of global significance
learningOutcomes.LO6_desc: Students connect their actions to broader social, cultural, environmental or ethical issues and show awareness of their impact. Evidence includes projects addressing real-world problems and critical reflection on global implications.
learningOutcomes.LO6: Students connect their actions to broader social, cultural, environmental or ethical issues and show awareness of their impact.
learningOutcomes.LO7_title: LO7 — Recognise and consider ethical implications
learningOutcomes.LO7_desc: Students reflect on the ethical dimensions of their choices and actions, showing thoughtful decision-making. This includes considering consequences, fairness, respect for others, and responsible use of resources.
learningOutcomes.LO7: Students reflect on the ethical dimensions of their choices and actions, showing thoughtful decision-making and consideration of consequences.
